Ichijou"Truth."

Sayo"Madam, control yourself! Difficult to accept, certainly. But now and then such people really do exist!"

Even while I am saying this, she has taken my arm. The refusal is still travelling; the arm has already been acquired.

Very efficient. My answer has become unnecessary before I have finished giving it. Perhaps I should say no earlier next time. Before the question. Before meeting her, ideally.

No, that would probably be treated as an invitation to ask what is troubling me. Another conversation, and by its conclusion she might have the other arm also.

Sayo"Beautiful manoeuvre, madam! The junior needs no effort, so the senior arrives with a grand display of confidence. That is how one takes command of the story!"
Sayo"Of course, the senior generally leads at the beginning and then loses everything in the final reversal. An established arrangement."
Kanae"No need to finish, Nanny! Pehle se jeet maan lo—assume the victory, and victory follows. That is the solution!"

Kageaki"No."
Kanae"There! You see!"
Ichijou"WOH MERI LINE HAI! I'M THE ONE WHO GETS TO SAY THAT!!"

――タムラのガレージしかない。

はあるまいと思えた。

――タムラのガレージしかない。


　村正を連れ出している暇はなかった。
　いざとなったら呼べば良い。だがおそらくその必要
はあるまいと思えた。

　あれはもっと安易な事件トラブルだ。
　予測される被害が軽いということを意味するもので
はないが。傷害、殺人が含まれる可能性もある。

　決して座視はできない。
　俺は駆けた。背後からも三つ――六つというべきか？
――の足音が続いている。

　いや。
　脇道からも、一つ――

en.html:
Assess the situation.

Masked men. Five, six, seven. Four driving the staff away. Three heading for one place.

The Tamura team seems to have been taking a nap. Bad luck—no. Luck has no part in this. That very opening must have been targeted.

Confusion has taken every staff member. Many are still lying where they slept, only staring with wide, motionless eyes.

The three men's target is Misao Oji, in a corner. Dazed, just trying to raise herself.

Short iron bars in the approaching men's hands. Crude weapons. For their purpose, entirely sufficient.

状況を確認。
　覆面の男が五、六、七人。うちの四人がスタッフを
追い散らし、三人が一箇所へ向かっている。

　タムラチームは丁度仮眠をとっていたところだった
らしい。運が悪い――いや。そんな筈はないか。
　運の問題などではなく、まさにその隙を狙われたに
決まっている。

　スタッフは例外なく惑乱の波に押し流されていた。
まだ寝転がったまま凝然と眼を<ruby>瞠<rt>みは</rt></ruby>るばかりの者も多い。
　三人に狙われている標的――ガレージの隅の皇路操
は、いま呆然としつつ体を起こそうとしていた。

　迫る覆面の手には短い鉄の棒。
　無骨かつ有用な凶器。

en.html:
The girl beside me takes a great step forward. Her gaze is fixed on the back of the leading man approaching Misao Oji. Of the three, he is in the most dangerous position.

That brief stop gave her legs time to catch up. How she means to stop him—no. At this instant, worrying must finish. If she is going, I must trust she has a method.

The other two are my responsibility.

I move. Behind me, an angry shout. Ichijou? The others seem to have arrived also.

Step in. Coming from behind like this, hitting the back will not do enough. Aim at the side, hook into the liver—

No. Change the line. This man must go down. No allowance for doubt.

Drive the blow beneath his armpit.

—A vital point. One strike, down.

ja.html:
隣の少女が大きく踏み込む。
　その視線が狙撃しているのは、皇路操に向かう三人
の先頭、最も危険な位置にいる男の背中。

　彼らの一瞬の停止は、少女の足に追いつかせるだけ
の余裕を与えていた。
　問題はどう制するかだが――この刹那、悩むことを
やめる。やるからには手立てがあるのだろうと信じる。

　俺は他の二人を制圧しなくてはならない。
　踏み出す。背後から怒声。一条か――彼女らも間に
合ったらしい。


　踏み込む。
　追いすがるこの格好、背面を狙う打撃は効果が薄い。
狙いは脇。肝臓を引っ掛けるように――否、軌道修正。
この男は確実に仕留める必要あり。

　腋の下を刺し穿つ。
　――一撃必倒の急所。

en.html:
Not even a scream comes out. Foaming at the mouth, he staggers hard against the man beside him.

If that fellow is surprised, the surprise does not last even one breath. He throws aside his companion—now only an obstruction—and keeps going for the target. Decisive. That much credit I must give.

But I will reach him before the weapon in his right hand comes down.

Plant the left foot.

Kick with the right.

男は悲鳴も上げなかった。
　泡を吹き、大きくよろけて隣の仲間に体を預ける。

　そちらの男が、驚きを覚えたとしても一呼吸に満た
ない間のことだった。
　今や障害でしかない仲間を跳ね除けて、標的を狙い
続ける――果断と評して良い行動。

　だが届く。
　男が右手の凶器を振り下ろすよりも、こちらの方が
速い。

　左足を踏み締め。
　右足で蹴る。

en.html:
So decisive, so unwilling to lose sight of his objective, that against me he has made no provision at all. The kick drives his side inward toward the spine. For half an instant he stands rigid.

Then, like a released spring, he flies away. Continuing his assault is now beyond his abilities. On that point, no doubt remains.

In the space that has opened, I see the young racer. Known to me indirectly, and directly also.
